instruction: Mark all emails in the Sent folder as unread

rules.sql: select count(*) = 0 from messageAttributes where attributeID = 59 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 10);

metadata.explanation: Task requires marking all emails in the Sent folder (folderID=10) as unread. The evaluator checks that NO messages have the 'read' attribute (attributeID=59) set to 1 in the Sent folder. Verified from database: Sent folder (folderID=10) contains 2 emails, attributeID 59 corresponds to 'read' status.
